title: ynh sensors ls --format json
description: Output of `ynh sensors ls <harness> --format json`. Bare array summarising the sensors a harness declares — the discovery surface a loop driver reads before deciding what to run. Envelope retrofit deferred, matching the other Phase 3 commands. `ynh sensors show` resolves one sensor in full and is a different shape.

name.description: The sensor's declared name, and the identifier `--only`, `ynh sensors show` and `ynh sensors run` take.

category.description: Fowler bucket: maintainability, architecture or behaviour. Free metadata for loop-driver triage; ynh enforces no semantics.

role.description: Role hint: regular, convergence-verifier or stuck-recovery. Absent means regular. A loop driver filters on this to find the run's done-check.

source_kind.description: Which source variant is set. Decides what running the sensor means: execute a command, read artifacts, or resolve a focus the driver must hand to an agent runtime.

format.description: Declared output format. Freeform by design — ynh does not parse sensor output, so this is a hint to the consumer rather than a contract ynh enforces.

inline_focus.description: True when the sensor declares its focus inline rather than referencing a named one. Inline focuses are scoped to the sensor and do not appear in the harness's top-level focus list.
